snippet.title: Castle Kong Launch Trailer! $5000 Bounty!
snippet.description:
Get Ready! On June 5th Drowning Monkeys launches their sophomore effort: Castle Kong.  CK is a love letter  to the golden age of arcades.  Insanely hard but fair, and in tact with a kill screen. 

We're also giving away $8000 total cash prizes. See the website for more details!

http://www.drowningmonkeys.com/castle-kong-bounty
